candidates.statement: Inventory is rejecting configuration values (configuration_valid=false, 14 configuration_rejections, 7 ERROR configuration_value_rejected logs with status 503), producing checkout errors and elevated latency propagated to gateway's inventory call.
candidates.uncertainty: Deployment record alone does not establish causation; no direct proof the rejected config value is the one causing 503s.

report.explanation: Inventory shows configuration rejections and 503 errors with elevated error rate and latency, and gateway's inventory call errors at ~2s. Gateway itself is healthy (error_rate 0.001, p95 72ms, INFO 200 logs). Bad configuration in inventory is the bounded, evidence-supported candidate; deployment record alone is not treated as causal.
missing_evidence: Inventory logs identifying which configuration key/value was rejected and its source
Confirmation that configuration_rejections correlate in time with the 503 checkout errors
